[Intro]
[C#5]

[Verse 1]
[A5]There's a
man who's just been
waiting here
[E5]All night long
[C#5]
[A5]As he
watches you he's
smiling there
[E5]all Alone
[C#5]

[Chorus]
[F#5]He ne-
eds something be-
[A5]tter but he
knows You're on your
[C#5]own

[Break]
[C#5]

[Verse 2]
[A5]All the
streetcreeps and their
pushers here
[E5]Have all gone
[C#5]
[A5]Slowly
swept below the
streets where they Be-
[E5]long
[C#5]

[Chorus]
[F#5]But there's
something not right,
[A5]its vio-
lence We love
[C#5]
[F#5]There's a
man in the dark-
[A5]ness
waiting for Blood
[C#5]

[Solo 1]
[C#5]
[A5]
[E5]
[C#5]
[A5]
[E5]
[C#5]

[Verse 3]
[A5]Watch the
broken tele-
vision come to
[E5]life
[C#5]
[A5]As the
story cuts right
through you like a
[E5]Knife
[C#5]

[Chorus]
[F#5]Under
cold neon light,
[A5]its vio-
lence we love
[C#5]
[F#5]And from the
gutter he crawls,
[A5]
waiting for Blood
[C#5]

[Solo 2]
[C#5]
